campaign.title: Hard TOP actual-character vector spectral gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Import no estimate unless its primary statement controls the literal hard affine vector with the actual quarter character, moving endpoints, stars, floors, one-count slabs, and L^2 energy target. Generic large-sieve or operator analogies are strategy evidence only.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact hard-TOP transposed actual-character vector be bounded at diagonal energy scale by a genuinely noninvertible signed spectral/operator inequality, or can every violation be localized to a smaller complete offset family before the hard-TOP lane is parked again?
frozen_target.reference_formula: R_m=sum_(h in H_L, m<=h<=4m) chi_4(h)a_end(h,m)e(sqrt(Xhm)); prove E_top=sum_m|R_m|^2<<_epsilon L^2X^epsilon, equivalently Re C_(L,tag)^comp<<_epsilon L^2X^epsilon for the one-orientation completed directional scalar.
quantities: X real at least 2, J=sqrt(X), and one polynomial intermediate hard-top height block L with bounded and terminal blocks already owned
R_m is the literal Round-75 row with chi_4(h) inside the h-sum, the hard affine range m<=h<=4m, the actual endpoint coefficient a_end(h,m), and zero extension
E_top=sum_m|R_m|^2 is nonnegative; its diagonal D_L is O_epsilon(L^2X^epsilon)
E_top=D_L+2Re C_L^off and also equals owned_L+2Re C_(L,tag)^comp with owned_L target-safe
one representative orientation h<s, equivalently primitive a<b, followed by one outer 2Re; both orientations plus 2Re are forbidden
C_L^off=sum_(a odd,q) (-1)^q F_(L,a)(q), with literal coprimality, odd lifts, moving ceiling, reciprocal intervals, collars, entries, exits, stars, floors, metric centres, and one-count slabs
fixed-a Gram, complex modulus, blockwise absolute mass, slabwise l1, adjacent total variation, scaled-comb transport, and another reciprocal transform are strictly stronger or already parked
the target is a positive actual-vector Bessel/contraction theorem or the equivalent one-sided real off-diagonal bound, not a coefficient-blind norm
hard TOP M2 owner only; BAL, UNBAL, all M1 owners, endpoint uniformity, and downstream graph parents excluded

completion_criteria: Reproduce the exact Round-75 hard vector, diagonal, off-diagonal, character parity, affine endpoints, one orientation, and Round-110 completed real-part equivalence.
State capacity before each inequality and distinguish the minimal actual-vector energy from complex, fixed-a, slabwise, offsetwise, transport, and coefficient-blind norms.
Test a parity-twisted noninvertible spectral/operator inequality on the complete m-vector before separating one-count slabs or reciprocal modes.
Retain every actual coefficient and phase seam; arbitrary aligned, random-sign, square/Pell/fourth-power, bulk-sampler, and endpoint controls must be answered.
Prove the L^2X^epsilon target, a strict target-safe complete offset subrange, a positive-power saving or inverse theorem, or the smallest rigorous no-go and exact parked survivor.
Audit all hard affine faces, support births and deaths, ceilings, collars, floors, stars, zero extension, and prior target-safe owners exactly once.
State exactly what follows for hard TOP, BAL, UNBAL, M9-M2, both M1 routes, endpoint uniformity, M9, the quarter theorem, and all exponents.

tasks.target: Independently derive the exact hard-TOP actual-character vector energy and prove its target, a strict complete-offset saving, a quantitative inverse theorem, or the smallest rigorous coefficient/spectral no-go.
excluded_context: all Round-75 through Round-126 nonblind artifacts
required_output: An exact derivation of the vector energy, diagonal and one-sided target.
A target estimate, strict saving, inverse theorem, or smallest no-go.
A promote, retain, revise, reject, or no-change recommendation.

tasks.target: Develop a noninvertible parity-twisted spectral/operator inequality for the complete actual m-vector, retaining one-count slabs jointly and exhibiting the full saving from coefficient-blind hard-TOP capacity to L^2.
required_output: The exact vector/operator and all comparison norms with capacities.
A proved inequality, strict subrange, inverse theorem, or first invalid seam.

tasks.target: Hostilely audit the hard-TOP vector target, parity spectral proposal, diagonal and off-diagonal capacities, resonant controls, one-count slabs, endpoints, and every claimed gain.
required_output: A pass/fail seam table for the exact vector, capacities, signs, resonances and endpoints.
The maximal safe theorem or exact fatal correction.
A precise state recommendation and parked survivor if the route fails.

review_seams.requirement: The proof uses the exact Round-75 a_end(h,m), hard affine interval, character inside the vector, and zero extension.
The positive vector energy and equivalent one-sided real off-diagonal are distinguished from complex, fixed-a, slabwise and coefficient-blind norms.
One h<s orientation and one outer 2Re are used; parity is retained before any norm.
The claimed gain comes from an actual signed operator inequality, not adjacent transport, comb total variation, another B-process, or random-sign credit.
Every norm states its diagonal and coherent capacity and answers arbitrary aligned vectors plus square, Pell, fourth-power and endpoint controls.
No hard-TOP result is promoted to BAL, UNBAL, complete M9-M2, M9, or an exponent without every graph bridge.
